_comment: Asset Store catalog. Each pack's content lives under packs/<id>/ mirroring INSTALL-RELATIVE paths (e.g. packs/tac/Mods/Tac/scripts.vol installs to <game>/Mods/Tac/scripts.vol). tools/publish-store.ps1 in the native repo validates this file, hashes the content, regenerates store.json, and commits. Adding an asset never touches the game manifest or bumps the game version.
credit: Thanks to Krogoth for keeping the classic Tribes mods online: https://theexiled.pwnageservers.com/

packs.title: Shifter
packs.description: Shifter, the 09-28-2000 release by Emo1313 of Dopplegangers -- the build everyone means by 'Shifter', and the one later mods still balance against. Seven armours including the Assassin, Goliath, Arbitor and Mercenary, deployable turrets, mines and stations you assemble in the field, vehicle modules, a huge weapon set, and one of the deepest admin toolkits ever written for Tribes. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Shifter or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Taylor Suchan (Emo1313), Dopplegangers

packs.title: Shifter HC (v1G)
packs.description: Shifter HC v1G, GreyFlcn's competitive fork of Shifter, final build 05-27-2002. Not a newer Shifter -- a different one. Everything the original has, plus the layer it was missing: tourney and match mode with ready-up, match tracking, ceasefire, fair teams, vote-for-leader, nuke and det counters for referees, and the anti-cheat work of a mod that was being played for stakes. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Shifter_v1G or use the toggle below.
packs.author: GreyFlcn, on Shifter by Taylor Suchan (Emo1313)

packs.title: Reality Bites 2.0
packs.description: Reality Bites 2.0 by Deadtaco, circa 2001: Tribes rebuilt around modern firearms on the stock maps. Over thirty weapons and pieces of gear -- the AK-74, FAMAS, Tommy gun, SAW, M2, SPAS and OICW, Glock and Beretta sidearms, molotovs and gas cans, kevlar, helmets, sandbags and sniper perches -- plus arena and KTag game types, combat drones and a civil-war mode. Launch with -mod rb2 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Deadtaco (Devin Crowley)

packs.title: Tribes Aerial Combat (TAC) 1.41
packs.description: Team Aerial Combat - teamwork-required flight combat by the TPG team (2001). Full client and server: 29 missions (CTF, C&H, TDM, D&D, F&R), custom skins and sounds, and the complete server-side scripts so you can host it. Launch with -mod Tac or use the toggle below.
packs.author: TAC Development Team

packs.title: Red Moon RPG (RMRPG)
packs.description: Red Moon RPG - the Tribes RPG variant that stacks on top of the base RPG mod: its own missions, skins, GUI and server scripts. Needed to join Red Moon servers. v8 adds the chocobo mounts (8 models and their 7 colour skins), 13 missing armour and robe skins, 8 missing terrain sets, and refreshes every script to the live server's build. v10 fixes servers running old copies of 46 of those scripts (wrong map and port, no chocobos). Launch with -mod rpg -mod rmrpg (RMRPG stacks on RPG) or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Red Moon RPG team
credits: Original mod: Red Moon RPG team

packs.title: Star Wars RPG (SWRPG)
packs.description: Star Wars Tribes RPG by Hazor and team - an RPG mod set in the Star Wars universe, built on the Star Wars TC 2.0 art and sounds: skins, models, terrain and scripts. v2 adds the recovered Tatooine server mission, so you can host the real map locally, plus 8 recovered robe and armor skins. Launch with -mod SWRPG or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Hazor / SWRPG team

packs.title: Star Wars TC 2.0 (full)
packs.description: The complete Star Wars total conversion: eight Star Wars maps (Dantooine, Tatooine, Battle of Hoth, Yavin Base, Mos Eisley, Mos Espa, Sarlaac Pit, Sith Knight) on the TC's own Star Wars terrain, custom vehicles, weapons, sounds and voices. HD textures (AI-upscaled where the originals were low resolution) and palettized, legacy .vol archives converted to .zip, and deduplicated against base Tribes so you download the mod rather than another copy of the game. Launch with -mod StarWars.
packs.author: Star Wars TC team
credits: Original mod: Star Wars TC team

packs.title: Annihilation
packs.description: Annihilation - the classic Tribes total conversion, both halves in one download: deployable turrets, jump pads, blast walls and force fields, twelve turret types, tanks and dropships, duels and arena modes, its own bots and admin suite, plus 643 missions, the community skin set and its HUDs. Host it or join with it. Launch with -mod TotalAnnihilation or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Annihilation team

packs.title: GoldenEye 007 + Perfect Dark Maps
packs.description: Nine maps recreated from GoldenEye 007 and Perfect Dark -- Facility, Complex, Caves, Egyptian, Temple, Library, Basement, Stack and Grid -- with flags, objectives and inventory stations for two teams. All 3,624 textures AI-upscaled 4x and palettized. Plays in base Tribes: no mod to select, the maps just appear.
packs.author: Map pack by the GoldenEye007 Tribes project; textures upscaled for Modern Tribes

packs.title: Starsiege: Full Conversion
packs.description: The complete Starsiege (1999) asset corpus converted to this engine and upscaled -- terrain, interiors, sounds, fonts and media, mounted as a mod. Launch with the toggle below to explore Dynamix's other universe inside Tribes.
packs.author: Dynamix (conversion: Modern Tribes project)

packs.title: Delta Air Force
packs.description: Modern air combat for Tribes: attack aircraft, helicopters and tanks you actually pilot, plus 20 mission maps built around them. A classic community mod preserved from the repack lineage. Launch with -mod DeltaAirForce or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Delta Air Force team
credits: Original mod: Delta Air Force team

packs.title: HD Normal Maps -- Full Coverage
packs.description: 5,756 additional normal maps that fill the gaps the per-terrain-pack sets leave. The HD terrain packs each carry normal maps for their own tiles, but most of the game's other surfaces -- base interiors, mod art, skins, effects -- had none, so bump lighting simply did not apply to them. This pack completes the coverage, so surfaces light with real depth everywhere instead of only on packaged terrain. Needs $pref::gpuNormalMap on (it is on by default). Purely visual: no gameplay change, no mod to select, and nothing depends on it.
packs.author: Generated for Modern Tribes with DeepBump
credits: Generated for Modern Tribes with DeepBump

packs.title: Upscaled Player Skin Pack
packs.description: 403 community skin packs from the classic Tribes era, AI-upscaled and added to your skin list. Every texture was run through the same 4xNomos8kDAT model used for the rest of Modern Tribes, resolved to 512 and palettized, so armour and emblems stay sharp up close without the download that full 4x would cost. Installs into base\Skins and appears in the skin selector -- no mod to launch, nothing else changes.
packs.author: Skins by their original community authors; upscaled for Modern Tribes

packs.title: Elite Renegades
packs.description: Elite Renegades 1.1b, Fire Team Alpha's classic Renegades ruleset as carried on by the Temples of Syrinx: reworked armours, weapons and stations, team-kill and station-camping limits, name bans, vote and public-admin controls and the BWadmin observer tools for shoutcasting, all on the stock maps. Ported to Modern Tribes by a community player. Launch with -mod EliteRenegades or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Fire Team Alpha / Temples of Syrinx (Modern Tribes port: community)
credits: Original mod: Fire Team Alpha / Temples of Syrinx

packs.title: 5150 v2 Voice Pack
packs.description: The 5150 v2 community voice pack: 1,172 quick-chat lines across the 5150, fan, others, poop and spark collections, plus its quick-chat menu (27 Global pages and extra Offense, Defense, Team and Animation lines) merged into your existing menu without replacing any stock command. Installing is the whole opt-in: after a restart the extra pages appear in the quick-chat menu, and other players who also have the pack hear the lines; players without it just see the text. Your Voice Volume and Play Voice Packs settings still apply. Console kill switch for the sending menu: $pref::voicePackMenus = 0. Contains explicit language. Credits: Linchy, Groove and the 5150 crew; the audio archives ship unmodified.
packs.author: Linchy, Groove and the 5150 crew
credits: Voices: Linchy, Groove and the 5150 crew

packs.title: Tribes 2 Armors, Props and Buildings
packs.description: The Tribes 2 art, converted for Modern Tribes: the five player armors (light, medium and heavy male, light and medium female) replace the stock armors while installed, with their Tribes 2 animations plus the stock crouch, throw, sign and pose clips transferred onto them; 242 props and vehicles as new shapes (t2_ names, for mappers' datablocks); and all 324 Tribes 2 buildings as native interiors that appear in the mission editor's Interiors palette on every map. Installs into its own folder, config\AssetPacks\tribes2 -- no mod to launch, nothing else changes, and Remove restores the stock armors. Because the pack owns its own folder, another pack shipping the same model name can no longer overwrite it, and a mod's own custom shape still wins over the pack's. Buildings are used by placing them in a mission; no map ships with them yet. Known gaps: the converted armors lack the two tumble clips (as stock heavies and mediums do), and buildings carry detail level 0 only. Buildings collide using Tribes 2's own collision data. Includes the converted Tribes 2 team skin art for the Player Setup appearance customizer.
packs.author: Dynamix (Tribes 2, 2001); converted with tools\t2port from the Modern Tribes repo

packs.title: Duel Tournament
packs.description: Duel Tournament by [HvC]NaTeDoGG -- the duel server mod the 1v1 scene actually ran, taken from the =Argh!='s Duel (PlayT1.com) tree and later maintained by Krayvok and Lestat. Challenge anyone on the server to a 1v1, pick your three weapons and pack, and fight it out in a private arena while everyone else keeps playing; plus team duels with leaders, rosters, trades and challenges, a deathmatch mode, ladder scoring and server records for fastest win, longest midair and best streak. Ships 227 duel and arena maps. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Duel or use the toggle below.
packs.author: [HvC]NaTeDoGG; maintained by Krayvok, Lestat and =Argh!=

packs.title: Herc Havoc
packs.description: The Starsiege HERCs, the way Starsiege had them. Built from a Starsiege player's guide: every HERC runs at Starsiege's own scale -- real speeds, real weapon velocities and ranges, its own reactor and its factory loadout. No heat, no shutdown, no jets: your reactor battery is the limit, shields and armour work the Starsiege way, and heavy hits shove you. Every HERC carries its Starsiege special components -- shield amplifiers, cloaks, boosters, NanoRepair and more -- swappable from the TAB menu, with mines on the mine key. The Starsiege soundtrack plays, the cockpit computer calls out shields, damage and power, and the cockpit HUD shows your reactor, systems and mines. Includes City on the Edge, the most-played Starsiege multiplayer map, as CTF, team and free-for-all, plus the Mech Mayhem arenas. Bots included. Needs the latest game update. Launch with -mod HercHavoc or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Modern Tribes project, after a Starsiege player's HERC guide; Starsiege art and audio by Dynamix
credits: After a Starsiege player's HERC guide

packs.title: IronSphere RPG
packs.description: IronSphere, the Tribes 2 RPG mod, ported to Tribes: its towns, dungeons, creatures, weapons and gear rebuilt for the Modern Client. In development.
packs.author: IronSphere RPG team (Modern Tribes port)

packs.title: Tribes 2 HD Asset Texture Pack
packs.description: Sharper textures for the Tribes 2 content: armors, weapons, props, vehicles, buildings and effects, AI-upscaled 4x from the original art. Transparent foliage and effect textures keep their original cut-outs. Also carries normal maps, so surfaces light with real depth ($pref::gpuNormalMap, on by default), and material maps that give metal, ice and water their shine ($pref::gpuMaterialMap). Needs the Tribes 2 Armors, Props and Buildings pack, and only changes how its textures look. Installs into its own folder, config\AssetPacks\tribes2-hd. There is no mod to launch, and Remove restores the originals. Upscaled with 4xNomos8kDAT by Philip Hofmann (CC-BY-4.0); normal maps generated with DeepBump by HugoTini (GPL-3.0).
packs.author: Dynamix (Tribes 2, 2001); upscaled for Modern Tribes

packs.title: 420Snipers (Beta)
packs.description: 420Snipers (Beta) by {420}Ice-Dragon (2003): an all-sniper mod. Everyone wears one armor, the Sniper, and the stock weapons are replaced with a sniper arsenal: Sniper Rifle, 420 Rifle, Predetor, Flesh Eater, Ice Laser, Heavy Metal and Bloody Tears. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Snipers420 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: {420}Ice-Dragon

packs.title: 5th Element v0.2
packs.description: 5th Element v0.2 by +]-[+Armagedon+ of Team Hybrid (January 2003): a Renegades-family class mod on the Insomniax engine. Nine Neo armors (Scout, Spy, Sniper, Mercenary, Burster, Engineer, Alien, Cyborg, Dragoon) carry a long weapon list: Hyper Spinfuser, Hyper Blaster, Rocket Launcher, Sniper Rifle, Magnum, Shockwave Cannon, Railgun, Vulcan Cannon, Flame Thrower, Ion Rifle, Omega Rifle, Plasma Cannon and a Homing Missile Cannon. Packs include the Vengeance Missile Pack (a programmable five-warhead launcher set up from the Tab menu), Cloaking, StealthShield, Nitrogen Jetpack, Impulse Pack, Command Laptop and DetPack; deployables include Ion, Flame, Laser, Shock, Mortar, Plasma and Vulcan turrets, force fields and stations you can pack up remotely. New vehicles: Wraith, Interceptor, Corsair, bomber LPCs and a Stealth HPC. Comes with the IX-Admin menus (team-kill protection, public-admin lockouts, discipline menu). Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod FifthElement or use the toggle below.
packs.author: +]-[+Armagedon+

packs.title: AAOD Mod 1.6Ex
packs.description: The AAOD clan's mod, version 1.6Ex (February 2000): base Tribes with an experience system on top. Kills, flag captures, repairs and destroyed enemy equipment earn experience; every level buys a special skill (Speed, Durability, Flight, Stealth, Accuracy, Regeneration, Energy Recovery), dying and team-killing cost experience, and high-level players carry a bounty. Around that sits a large kit of extra armors, weapons and deployables (mobile bunkers, alarms, mobile generators, shield generators, Ambusher and mortar turrets, the Stasis Cannon, the Bunker Buster and more) with in-game help text you can switch off from the Tab menu. Experience is kept per session by default; a server owner can switch on saved experience in the config file next to the mod. Some of its sounds came in separate AAOD sound packs that are not part of this release. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod AAOD or use the toggle below.
packs.author: AAOD clan (Valya[AAOD])

packs.title: Advanced War
packs.description: Advanced War (2002-2005, built on *DK*SlipKnot*'s Paint Ball scripts): stock Tribes turned into a modern-war mod. The three armors become Soldier mk I, II and III, and the arsenal adds a 9mm pistol, a second chaingun, two plasma variants, a Missile Launcher, a multi-rocket launcher, a Twin Fuser and an Air-Strike Gun that calls a gunship in over the spot you mark. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod AdvWar or use the toggle below.
packs.author: unknown (built on Paint Ball by *DK*SlipKnot*)
credits: Original author unknown (built on Paint Ball by *DK*SlipKnot*)

packs.title: AEON
packs.description: AEON by Ice (2008): a persistent role-playing sandbox for Tribes, on its own map (Free). There are no teams and no flag. You make a character with a password, earn cash, buy and build property, rent books to unlock skills, harvest meteor rocks, smelt metal, combine materials into goods, trade with other players, bank your money and post classified ads; karma follows what you do. Characters, banks and property are saved on the server between sessions. Type #commands in chat (#skills, #time, #save, #stuck) and bind actions to the activator keys. Server-side: people can join your server without installing anything. Host it on the mission Free; when you join, type a new profile password twice in chat, then fire to spawn. Launch with -mod Aeon or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Ice

packs.title: Alliance
packs.description: The Alliance Engine (2000) by Alazane, with Mjolnir, Mephisto and Kevin "Savage1" Savage: the Tribes server scripts rebuilt so every armor, weapon, pack and deployable is its own module, with the Insomniax admin system (public-admin and voting lockouts, anti-team-kill levels, fair teams, personal skins). Ships all three of its original rule sets in one pack: Pure Alliance (Sprint, Commando, Loader and Destroyer classes with the engine's own weapons and deployables; the default), Base Tribes (the three stock armors and stock weapons on the engine) and Renegades Alliance (Scout, Spy, Sniper, Mercenary, Engineer, Burster, Alien, Cyborg). Pick the rule set in AllianceSettings.cs ($Alliance::RuleSet). Plays on the stock maps. Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod Alliance or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Alazane, Mjolnir, Mephisto, Kevin "Savage1" Savage
credits: Original mod: Alazane, Mjolnir, Mephisto, Kevin "Savage1" Savage

packs.title: Anarchy
packs.description: ANARCHY mod 2.0 by DRONE1000 (teamanarchy.com), server build by ^Plasmatic^, early 2001: a big Renegades-style class mod. A long list of armor classes, each with its own grenade type (hologram mines, shock, fire, tranquiliser, concussion and nuke bombs), 123 items, 21 turrets, 5 vehicles; weapons include dual rocket launchers, EMP gun and EMP mortar, shotgun, taser, flame and vulcan packs, mini rail and ion packs, a generator gun, and status effects (burning, poison, short-circuit, taser). Deployables include force-field doors, a portable generator and inventory stations. Admin tools in the Tab menu: public and super admin with per-option lockouts, De-tongue (gag), Freeze, BlowUP-n-Kill, anti team-kill levels, fair teams, personal skins. No password ships; set your own in Anarchy.cs. Plays on the stock maps. Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod Anarchy or use the toggle below.
packs.author: DRONE1000 (server build and admin by ^Plasmatic^)
credits: Original mod: DRONE1000 (server build and admin by ^Plasmatic^)

packs.title: Ultra Renegades 3 v. Anarchy
packs.description: ULTRA RENEGADES 3 .V. ANARCHY BETA (February 2003): the Anarchy tribe's edit of Ultra Renegades 3 League (UR3 by URG_Thrash, League version by ($A$)FSB-Deacon, updated by Dr. NoRtOn, height limit by {187}George W., VX rifles by Kissie-Poo). Fast competition play: the beacon key is a speed booster, the grenade key is an air brake and the targeting laser is an altimeter; players spawn with 100 of each. 69 items, flag-carrier height alarm, the UR (Insomniax) admin menu with public-admin and public-vote lockouts, fair teams and anti team-kill levels. New joiners pick personal or team skin from a menu. Plays on the stock maps. Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod AnarchyUR or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Anarchy tribe edit (UR3 League by URG_Thrash, ($A$)FSB-Deacon, Dr. NoRtOn, {187}George W.)
credits: Original mod: Anarchy tribe edit (UR3 League by URG_Thrash, ($A$)FSB-Deacon, Dr. NoRtOn, {187}George W.)

packs.title: AnAThrax Mod
packs.description: AnAThrax's weapons mod from October 1999 (the release has no version number). Base Tribes with six armors (Scout, Light, Medium, Defense, Heavy and Destruction) and a much bigger arsenal: Sniper Rifle, RPG and Advanced RPG, Fusion Gun, Napalm Gun, Poison Gas Gun, Liquid Fire Launcher, the Frier, Blast Mortar, an EMP Launcher that drains a target's energy and knocks the weapon out of their hands, and a Nuke. Only the light classes can pilot vehicles, and the LPC is a bomber. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Anathrax or use the toggle below.
packs.author: AnAThrax

packs.title: Apocalypse Mod
packs.description: Apocalypse Mod 1.6 by ProtoManX (2003), built on Nicodemus's Foundation Mod. Seven armors (Peltast, Hoplite, Myrmidon, Quicksilver, Guardian, Centurion and the huge Apocalypse) and about thirty weapons: Rail Gun, Fusion Rifle, Flame Thrower, Liquid Nitrogen Canister, Nanite Cannon, Phantom Gun, Barrage Cannon, Homing Missile Launcher, Poison Dart Gun, Boom Stick and the Apocalypse Cannon. Many weapons and packs have several firing modes, picked under Personal Settings in the Tab menu or, with Modules on, bought at a station as chokes, cores and bomb modules. Elemental damage (fire, storm, impact, electricity) with an Elemental Barrier pack, a Grappler Beam, a Ghost Pack, deployable Disc, Frost, Fusion, Laser, Machine Gun and Plasma turrets, five vehicles, and four spawn sets (Rush, Pilot, Repair, Power). Admins get a Server Options menu and a melee-only switch. Server-side: it uses the game's own models, so people can join your server without installing anything; only the host needs the pack. Plays on the stock maps. Launch with -mod ApocalypseMod or use the toggle below.
packs.author: ProtoManX (Foundation Mod by Nicodemus; code credits to Ice/Devastor and Creeperman in the readme)
credits: Foundation Mod by Nicodemus; code credits to Ice/Devastor and Creeperman in the readme

packs.title: Apollo 11 Mod 0.4 Alpha
packs.description: Apollo 11 Mod for Tribes v0.4 Alpha by Bloodhype (AWACS.net), one of the first Tribes mods. It adds the Apollo 11, a highly explosive rocket you ride, open to every armor class and nearly twice as fast as a Scout, and the Rocketeer, a light armor that gives up firepower to run faster and fly almost indefinitely. New weapons: Flamethrower, Nuke Silo and Mini Nuke Silo, RPG, a flechette Sniper Rifle, the Shockfury (the ELF's tougher brother), the Stormblast air cannon and a Repair Shell that fixes everything in its blast. Deployables: force fields in two sizes, a Decoy Flag that is also a mine, and Apollo's Wrath, a ten-second bomb limited to one per team. Plus the Phantasm Pack, which fades its wearer in and out of sight. Most of the new guns borrow stock weapon models, as the author's notes say. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Apollo11 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Bloodhype (AWACS.net)

packs.title: Apteryx v2
packs.description: Apteryx v2 by Crow! (2003), built on Annihilation 2.1: "the world of flightless armors and armed fliers". Armors have weak jets and no sniper rifles, so fights are won on the ground with strategy while the air belongs to vehicles and drones. Armor classes Scorpion, Berserker, Lynx, Firth, Energy Artillery, Destroyer and the Drone Commander, who launches Laser, Chaingun, Grenade, Anti-Turret, Guardian, Air and Hunter drones. Around thirty weapons (Kinetic Maul, Hydra Machine Gun, Plasma Cannon, Railgun, Anti-Matter Launcher, Electro-Magnetic Lance, Shatter Storm, Healing Laser, Shield Projector ...), eleven base turrets, deployable shields, fire walls and stations, and four vehicles: Wyvern fighter, Rubicant gunship, Bahamut bomber and a Dropship. Keeps Annihilation's admin and voting menus. Server-side: people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Apteryx or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Crow! (built on Annihilation by Sevnn, Plasmatic and the Annihilation Development Team)
credits: Original mod: Crow! (built on Annihilation by Sevnn, Plasmatic and the Annihilation Development Team)

packs.title: Armageddon (Meltdown v w00)
packs.description: Armageddon, the =(w00)= clan's 2002 build of Meltdown by GreyWolf with VRWarper. A heavy Meltdown / HaVoC style arsenal on the normal Tribes maps: Blastech, Mag-Ion and MECH armours beside the stock ones, around 30 weapons with selectable fire modes (MB Cannon, Vulcan chaingun), deployable turrets, shield nodes and power items, air strikes and 21 vehicles. It also carries the clan's admin bot: score tracking with !register, ban lists by name, tag and address, alias logging, a team-kill limit and a large super-admin menu. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything; a few of its custom sounds are not in the release and stay silent. Admin passwords are set in Mods\Armageddon\Meltdown.cs, not with $AdminPassword. Launch with -mod Armageddon or use the toggle below.
packs.author: |*|w00|*|GreyWolf and [GL]VRWarper (Meltdown by INH*DynaBlade)

packs.title: Asylum 2.5
packs.description: Asylum 2.5 (Asylum2, June 2000): a weapons-and-armour mod built straight on stock Tribes. Six armours replace the stock three (Resistor, Assasin, RadCon, Valkyrie, Devastator, Colossus) and the arsenal grows to 19 weapons: Equalizer, Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Laser Shredder, Blast Launcher, Soul Stealer (drains the target's energy), Gravity Gun, Cloaking Gun, Earthquake Cannon, Fallout Cannon (leaves radiation that keeps hurting), Repair Gun and the stock guns. Deployables add air platforms, small and large force fields, a laser turret, a satellite camera and flag mines; there are five vehicles. Plays on the normal Tribes maps. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Asylum or use the toggle below.
packs.author: The Asylum team (planetstarsiege.com/asylum)

packs.title: {ATF} Mod
packs.description: {ATF} Mod (Attack Team Force, "v1.0.beta.I.guess", 2004) by {ATF}HaCk, three years of one author's ideas on top of the Foundation mod. Eleven armours (Light, Medium, Heavy, Goliath, Mechanic, Bounty Hunter, Mach 5, Saiyan, Undead, Xythilian, HaCk) and about eighty weapons, from the stock guns to the BFG, FlameThrower, MiniGun, Comet Rifle, Kame-Ha-Me-Ha, Air Strike, Ghost-Rocket Launcher and a gun whose shot pulls people in before it explodes. Deployable turrets, walls, force fields, holograms, air platforms and trees for building a sky base. A talking Server God hands out mod tips and now and then starts a bonus round (Blood Lust: extra points per kill; Anti-Team Warfare). Admins can ask him for items in chat ("ServerGod: GiveMe <item> <count>"); he says no most of the time, fatally. Server-side: it uses the game's own models, so people can join your server without installing anything; only the host needs the pack. Plays on the stock maps. Launch with -mod ATF or use the toggle below.
packs.author: {ATF}HaCk; built on the Foundation mod by Nicodemus, with code from Shifter, Plasmatic and Balance of Power (readme)
credits: Built on the Foundation mod by Nicodemus, with code from Shifter, Plasmatic and Balance of Power (readme)

packs.title: DuelMOD (base Duel)
packs.description: DuelMOD (2000) by Drink|Kahlua: a one-on-one duel game type for stock Tribes. On a Duel map everyone starts as an observer; pick three weapons and a pack from the Tab menu (Blaster, Chaingun, Disc Launcher, Grenade Launcher, Laser Rifle, Plasma Gun, ELF Gun; Energy, Repair, Shield or Ammo Pack), select a player and ask for a duel. Up to twelve duels run at once, each on its own spot, with an announcer for the start and the finish. Ships four Duel maps (DuelMap, Duelmap2, Duelmap3, Duelmap4); on any other map the server plays the normal stock game. Server-side: people can join without installing anything; players who also install it hear the announcer. Launch with -mod BaseDuel or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Drink|Kahlua

packs.title: Dynamix Plus
packs.description: Dynamix Plus MOD 1.1 (Dynamix, June 2000): the developers' own rebalance of stock Tribes. You are shielded and weaponless for six seconds after a respawn, the chaingun fires faster with more spread and less damage per bullet, the mortar, ELF gun and repair pack reach further, mines are harder to shoot away before they arm, vehicle pads have shields, medium armour is faster and tougher, vehicles are faster and tougher, and the team list shows how many players each team has. Same items, maps and menus as stock Tribes. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Plus or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Dynamix

packs.title: Beginner Mod
packs.description: Beginner Mod by Dustin Bruce (2003): a starting point for people who want to write their own Tribes mod. It is stock Tribes with every armour, weapon, backpack, deployable and turret moved into its own small script file (Weapons, BackPacks, Deployables, Turrets, Misc, ArmorData, ProjectileData) and registered through one helper call each, so adding a new weapon is one new file and one line. Players see normal Tribes: the same items, maps and menus. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod BeginnerMod or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Dustin Bruce

packs.title: BioWasteland
packs.description: BioWasteland 7.5 by Biohazard: a large sandbox mod with ten armour classes (Runner, Scout, Spy, Engineer, Burster, Alien, Juggernaught and more), over forty weapons and about a hundred packs and deployables -- turrets, blast walls and floors, force fields, bunkers, an air base, teleporters, jails, missiles and vehicles. Most weapons and packs have their own settings under the Tab menu (Options, then Item or Weapon Options). Adds its own mission types -- Capture Energy, Bone Collector, Vehicle Capture, Elimination, Racing, Duel, Boxing, Titan and Smear the Flag -- and ships 14 maps, including an example map for each type. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod BioWasteland or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Biohazard (exploratoriums.com)

packs.title: Blitzkrieg
packs.description: Blitzkrieg 1.0b BETA by I/O deRost (September 2000): stock Tribes with six more weapons, three more turrets and re-roled vehicles. Weapons: Hornet Rifle, Gauss Cannon, Vulcan (medium armour), high-powered Laser Rifle that runs on batteries, Masterson Cannon (heavy armour) and Bounce Mortar. Turrets: deployable Chain Turret and Flak Turret (fires at vehicles only). Vehicles: the Scout becomes the Interceptor with flechette guns, the LPC becomes a Minelayer that scatters mines, the HPC a faster APC; damaged vehicles trail smoke and fire. Medium armour is a little stronger. Plays on the stock maps. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Blitzkrieg or use the toggle below.
packs.author: I/O deRost

packs.title: Blur of Insanity
packs.description: Blur of Insanity by SipHoN (2002): a class and gadget mod built from HaVoC parts. You spawn as a Medic with a Repair Shockwave launcher and pick a class at the inventory station. About thirty weapons, among them the Taser, Flame Thrower, Tranquilizer Gun, Compression Cannon, Time Bomb Setter, Torch Grenades, MoonDust Vaporizer, Polymorph Transmitter and EMP Shockwave, plus packs and deployables such as the Teleportation Pack, Cloaking Pack, Clone, Flag Decoy, Flag Bomb, ELF and Flame turrets and alarm systems. Plays on the stock maps. This is the mod as released: a few of its items were never finished (the Mortar has no ammunition, for one). Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod BlurOfInsanity or use the toggle below.
packs.author: SipHoN (built on HaVoC)

packs.title: Balance of Power
packs.description: BALANCE OF POWER 1.85 (September 1999) by James C. Vetsch aka Hak|Hakuryu: a class mod that keeps the stock Tribes feel. Besides the light, medium and heavy armors there are a Flag Runner, a Medic (repairs faster) and a Sensor Jammer armor, each in male and female form, with their own weapon and pack limits; extra deployables (walls, force fields, flag mines and more turrets) and two extra vehicles. The mod keeps a tally for every player: kills per weapon, flag captures and drops, items and teammates repaired. You see your own counts under Ammunition in the inventory, and the end-of-mission screen names the top flag capper, repairer, sniper and mortar user with a rank. 78 items. New joiners pick personal or team skin from a menu. Plays on the stock maps. Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod BOP or use the toggle below.
packs.author: James C. Vetsch (Hak|Hakuryu)

packs.title: Chivalry
packs.description: Chivalry v2.0 by the Sojourn Development Team (September 2000): a knights-and-magic mod with ranks that carry over between visits. Everyone starts as a Page in Warrior armor and earns titles such as Man-at-Arms, Legionnaire, Knight and Cavalier by score; the server keeps each name's rank, score and team kills on file, guarded by a character password. Classes include Warrior, Ranger, Crusader, Cleric, Mage and Crafter, with spells (Heal, Shield, Brimstone, Stasis, Turn Undead, Resurrection), altars and rituals next to weapons like the Predator, Scattergun, DaHammer, Shredder and the Storm and Trident launchers. A super admin can hold a crowning ceremony to name a Paladin and a Warlord, and there is an Undead side led by a Litch King. Team killers are tracked and kicked at a limit. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Server owners: the mod keeps player names, addresses and character passwords in temp\ReturnPlayers.cs in plain text; read the notes at the top of Mods\Chivalry\Chivalry.cs. Launch with -mod Chivalry or use the toggle below.
packs.author: [CLU]Robear and [CLU]Clu (Sojourn Development Team)

packs.title: CiSYGY Server Mod
packs.description: CiSYGY Server Mod PR1 by Sundiata of CiSYGY (February 1999), one of the earliest Tribes weapon mods. It adds a Sniper Rifle that fires chaingun bullets, an Energy Cannon that needs an Energy Pack, Advanced Armor, and three more aircraft at the vehicle station (Stalker, Fighter and the MPC troop carrier). Team energy is limited and trickles back, so a team has to budget what it buys. Everything else is stock Tribes and it plays on the stock maps. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod CiSYGY or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Sundiata (CiSYGY)

packs.title: C&C Tribes V2
packs.description: C&C: Tribes V2 by Lennex Production Studios (2000): a Command & Conquer themed conversion built on the Alliance engine. Adds its own soldier model, modern firearms (Beretta, M4 Carbine, HK G3, AK47, Walther sniper rifle, Bazooka, flame thrower), aircraft (Orca, Apache, Harrier, Chinook, A-10), Tiberium ore, a Harvester class, deployable Powerplant and Construction Yard buildings, Pillbox and NOD turrets, plus a large set of Alliance armour classes, weapons, packs and deployables. Weapon firing modes are under the Tab menu (Weapon Options). Ships the two official C&C maps (CC-artimis, CC-majortom) and 58 prefab buildings for map makers. This pack carries the mod's models and textures, so everyone who joins needs it installed. Launch with -mod CNCTRIBESV2 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Lennex Production Studios

packs.title: Nappy Cocaine
packs.description: Nappy Cocaine v1.3 by SSSneeky (2004), based on Nappy V4 by NHOP: a heavy-arsenal build-and-destroy mod. Hyper versions of the chaingun, disc launcher and railgun, nuke launchers and a nuke turret, an Omega Cannon, flame thrower, dart and ion rifles, a B-17 bomber and an Me-263 fighter, and a long list of deployables: blast walls and doors, force fields, platforms, teleport pads, jail cells, an underground base and eighteen deployable prefab buildings by C|one (bunkers, dropships, towers, a pyramid). Engineers can hack enemy equipment or protect their own. Comes with the Insomniax admin menu (team-kill protection levels, public admin lockouts) and per-admin passwords. Several item and armor names are crude and drug-themed. Lists Capture the Flag and Deathmatch maps. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Server owners: admin passwords are the $CocaineAdmin lines of Mods\NappyCocaine\CocaineOptions.cs; the pack ships none. Launch with -mod NappyCocaine or use the toggle below.
packs.author: SSSneeky (based on Nappy V4 by NHOP)
credits: Original mod: SSSneeky (based on Nappy V4 by NHOP)

packs.title: Cybrid 2K5
packs.description: +Cybrid+ 2K5 "The Cybrid Wars" by Armageddon and WorstAim, August-September 2005: the unfinished successor to the Hybrid mods, rebuilt on Ultra Renegades VX Elite. Two factions, Hybrid and Cybrid, each with light, medium and heavy armor, about a hundred weapons -- phazer and fusion rifles, ION and Armageddon cannons, pulse gauss, antimatter rockets, toxic throwers -- fourteen grenade types, deployables and four vehicles, plus flag effects, per-player statistics and a chat-command admin system (!help, !stats, !pm, !sad). This is a development snapshot: a few features call code that was never written, and its T-Mail player mail is switched off in this port. Admin passwords go in Mods\Cybrid2K5\2K5Config.cs. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Cybrid2K5 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Armageddon and WorstAim (Hybrid Development Team); built on Ultra Renegades VX Elite and the secureBase admin scripts
credits: Original mod: Armageddon and WorstAim (Hybrid Development Team)
Built on Ultra Renegades VX Elite and the secureBase admin scripts

packs.title: DBZ 3k
packs.description: DBZ_3k (December 2000): a small Dragon Ball Z themed weapons mod. The stock guns become energy attacks (a Kame-Hame-Ha beam, a Spirit Bomb, a Destructo Disk, eye lasers, a lightning attack), with three new weapons on top: a twin Hyper Blaster, a twin Energy Beam and Goku's own Kame-Hame-Ha for light armor. The chaingun and the grenade launcher are taken out of the shop, and jets cost far less energy, so everyone flies. Scripts only: no models, pictures or sounds are added. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Uses the game's own rules and admin menu. Launch with -mod DBZ_3k or use the toggle below.
packs.author: not named in the archive
credits: Original mod: not named in the archive

packs.title: Delta Force
packs.description: DeltaForce 1.0 by Nick "Enigma" Musurca, with maps by Thrax-THC-: modern infantry combat instead of jetpacks. There is no jetpack at all, most weapons kill in one or two hits, and you pick a job -- Infantry, Medic, Sniper, SpecOps, Army Engineer, Pilot or Artillery. Real-world weapons (SOCOM pistol, OICW rifle, M249 SAW, silenced MP5, SPAS-12, two sniper rifles, flamethrower, LAW, Stinger), parachutes, grappling hooks, called-in airstrikes and explosive charges, and vehicles with crew seats: Abrams tank, HMMWV with a wire-guided TOW missile, M113 carrier, Apache, A-10 Warthog and Blackhawk. Adds Hostage and VIP Assassination game types and ships its own 12 maps, built with ramps and elevators because nobody can fly. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything; playing with the mod loaded also gives you its weapon models, camouflage skins and sounds. Grenade, shotgun, MP5 and airstrike modes are under the Tab menu (Options, then Weapon Options). The parent of Delta Air Force. Launch with -mod DeltaForce or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Nick "Enigma" Musurca; maps by Ron "Thrax-THC-" Freas; weapon models by tenabrae; skins by the Ultra Renegades team
credits: Skins by the Ultra Renegades team

packs.title: Destroyer Mod
packs.description: Destroyer Mod by {SOF} Snake eye (2002), built on the Foundation mod. Six armors (Warrior, Psycic, Charger, Builder, Avenger and Mech), each with its own weapon list, and about twenty-five weapons: Railgun, Rocket Launcher, Fission and Fusion Launchers, Flame Thrower, Chemical Sprayer, Liquid Nitrogen Blast, Lightning, Fire Ball, Energy Disc, Double and Super Chainguns, Blast Cannon and Death Cannon. The Builder carries a repair rifle and deploys Chaingun, Flame, Ion, Laser and Mini-Plasma turrets, blast walls, force field doors and plasma floors; other packs include Cloaking, Power Enhancement, Fuel and Nitrogen tanks and a Suicide Pack. Fire sets players burning. Typing "lets gamble" in chat is a bet: most of the time you die, sometimes you get super health or the Super armor. Server-side: it uses the game's own models, so people can join your server without installing anything; only the host needs the pack. Plays on the stock maps. Launch with -mod DeStRoYeR or use the toggle below.
packs.author: {SOF} Snake eye (Foundation mod by Nicodemus)
credits: Original mod: {SOF} Snake eye (Foundation mod by Nicodemus)

packs.title: Devastator
packs.description: Devastator Mod BETA v0.99 by Ice (2002): a large server-side weapons mod. Armour classes Pilot, Strider, Sniper, Specialist, Engineer, Pyro, Heavy Infantry, Titan and Psycho, and 183 items: clip-fed pistols, shotguns, assault and sniper rifles that reload, a flamethrower, beam cannon, sword, tazer, keg launcher, nuclear and kamikaze weapons, eight hand-grenade types picked from the Tab menu, fire modes per weapon, fighters and bombers with their own weapon sets, vehicle maintenance pads, force floors, gun and wing buddies, a personal inventory, fireworks, and a chat robot that answers questions about the weapons and warns players about their language. Admins can turn themselves or others into Light, Dark or Demi GODs. Server-side: it uses only stock models, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Devastator or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Ice

packs.title: Devious Land
packs.description: DeviousLand v1.46 by Mojica (March 1999): four factions that each buy their own armors and weapons. Vandals get Kinetic Armor, a Sniper Suit, a hologram decoy, the HyperBlaster and the Interceptor; the Empire gets Doom and Erector armor, the Doom Cannon, erector walls and a flying tank; Arbiters get fusion guns, the Chosen Rifle, pods and a satellite; the Insatiable are an alien brood with larvae, spore mines, a spore thrower and nests that keep growing. Which faction a team plays is decided by its team name (Vandals, Empire, Arbiters, Insatiable): the pack names the teams Vandals and Empire for you unless your server already uses faction names. Plays on the stock maps. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod DeviousLand or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Mojica (misterdevious)

packs.title: DogFight 1.5
packs.description: DogFight 1.5 by {SOF} Snake eye (October 2002): an air combat mod. Nine aircraft (F-14 to F-19, the B-12 bomber, the Destroyer with its anti-matter ray and a scout) bought at the vehicle station or carried as a deployable pack and unfolded anywhere flat; every pilot spawns with a pistol and a parachute. On the ground: minigun, rail driver, heavy AA cannon, lock-on Stinger, hand-held anti-matter launcher and two deployable flak turrets to defend the base. Two armors, light and heavy. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Uses the game's own admin menu. Launch with -mod DogFight or use the toggle below.
packs.author: {SOF} Snake eye; parachute by Nick Musurca (Delta Force)

packs.title: Enhanced Base v2
packs.description: Enhanced Base v2 by Timer[TiZ] (May 2000): stock Tribes, rebalanced. Light armor loses the laser rifle and grenade launcher, medium armor gains the laser rifle and a fifth weapon, heavy armor is slower and tougher and carries six weapons. The laser rifle kills with a headshot, the hand mortar hits like the mortar turret, the chaingun is more accurate, the blaster, plasma gun and chaingun do more damage, the ELF gun reaches further, the repair pack works at long range and the energy pack recharges faster. Dropped items come back after a second, you respawn automatically, and there are new death messages. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod EnhancedBase or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Timer[TiZ]

packs.title: Eradication
packs.description: Eradication 1.4 (August 2000) by Dissident. A Tribes server mod with 82 items on the stock maps, built around roles: Light, Medium, Heavy, Support and Command armors, and Scout, Sniper, Assault, Defender, Stealth, Minelayer, Repulsor and Commander packs in place of the stock energy, ammo and shield packs. Weapons include the AutoBlaster, Shotgun and Plasma Shotgun, MultiGrenade Launcher, Howitzer, Superball Launcher and Repulsor Gun; deployables include a range of turrets, decoy turrets, barriers, crates and suspended platforms. The host gets an Eradication Options page in the Tab menu (station kicks, team-kill banning, disarming, score and death messages). Mines and sensors sit in their own inventory slots. Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod Eradication or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Dissident

packs.title: ET War
packs.description: ET War by Rkon (the TK clan's mod): stock Tribes with the arsenal rebuilt. The weapon slots become a Dual Zapper, Railgun, Mini Rocket Launcher, Bounce Rifle, Blade Flinger, Napalm and Flamethrower; plasma sets enemies on fire, and a shot into a Flame Pack or Mortar Pack on someone's back blows it up. The scout is a fast gun-armed fighter, and a player standing in a Command Station gets a Command List on the Tab menu that spends team energy on an orbital strike or a vehicle drop where the commander camera is looking. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod ETWar or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Rkon

packs.title: Extreme
packs.description: Extreme by Jason Avina (February 2000), the light sibling of his Orion Mod: stock Tribes weapons and items with a handful of rule changes. You spawn with only a disc launcher and a repair kit, light armor cannot carry the grenade launcher, medium and heavy armor can pilot the APCs, mines ignore teammates in team games, the blaster bolt flies faster, jump impulse is reduced to slow skiing, and flag scoring is reworked (10 for a capture, 1 for a return, minus 1 for dropping it near the enemy stand). Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Extreme or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Jason Avina

packs.title: Fallout (alpha)
packs.description: Fallout (alpha) by Floater (2005): a base-Tribes mod about commanding machines. Seven armors (Recon, Light, Medium, Floater, Power, Machine Control and Anti-Aircraft) and new weapons: the Lava Gun that pours burning flows, an unpredictable Radiation Gun, quad Anti-Aircraft rockets, the Andromeda Railgun and the Incendia Amnis super blaster. The Ex Machina guns spawn robot minions that fight for you: attackers you steer with voice commands (V V M to follow, V T F to deploy) and artillery bots that fire on whatever you paint with the targeting laser. Also a Troop Transport pack and the Zapper. An unfinished alpha, shipped as its author left it. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Fallout or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Floater

packs.title: Tribes Football
packs.description: Tribes Football (Football_Tasermod v5.7.5): two teams, one ball, two end zones. Carry or throw the ball into the other team's end zone for a touchdown; tackle the carrier to make him fumble. You spawn with one tool, the Football Thrower, which passes the ball; with Gun Fumble on, a thrown one that hits the carrier can knock the ball loose. Halves with a halftime break, out-of-bounds, an idle-ball reset, votes, and under the Tab menu a full set of host options: Gun Fumble, Hot-Potato mode, tackle after touchdown, mix up teams, Match Mode with captains and saved match stats. This is the server mod that makes the football stadium maps the client already ships playable, and it adds 10 more: four GSL stadiums (JAFS, Nameless Stadium, Stingray Stadium, XenoMorphic), five Fireball maps (a round-based elimination variant; a round starts once each team has two players) and LN2 QuadPoints (hit the wall panels with the ball for double or quad points). Server-side, so people can join without installing anything; players who also run the mod get the football model, the yellow flag skin and the stadium sounds (whistles, crowd, horn). Launch with -mod Football or use the toggle below.
packs.author: JeremyIrons; Spike, Greasey, aRc, LackeyNo2, Taserman (client art: Angel Kill)
credits: Spike, Greasey, aRc, LackeyNo2, Taserman (client art: Angel Kill)

packs.title: Football 1vs1
packs.description: Football 1vs1 Mod (Taserman, 2003): one-on-one Tribes football. Everyone on the server watches from observer mode; press Tab, pick a player and choose Request 1vs1, and when he accepts the two of you are dropped into a small stadium with one ball and two end zones. First to 10 touchdowns wins, and you have to win by 2. Each of the six maps holds four stadiums, so up to four duels run side by side while everyone else watches, and the server keeps win counts, fastest-win times and winning streaks. Six 1vs1 maps: BaLLiN, Coliseum, LN2, Off9, Stone Floor and TK-421. Built on the Football Mod 1.32 rules, which come in the pack, so the football stadium maps the client already ships also play as normal team football under this mod. Server-side, so people can join without installing anything; players who also run the mod get the football model, the yellow flag skin and the stadium sounds. Needs at least two players for a duel. Launch with -mod Football1v1 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Taserman (duel code after NateDog's Duel mod); Football Mod by JeremyIrons, Spike, Greasey, aRc, LackeyNo2 (client art: Angel Kill)
credits: Original mod: Taserman (duel code after NateDog's Duel mod)
Football Mod by JeremyIrons, Spike, Greasey, aRc, LackeyNo2 (client art: Angel Kill)

packs.title: Foundation Mod II
packs.description: Foundation Mod II by ProtoManX (2005-2006), built on Nicodemus's Foundation Mod (2000): stock Tribes taken apart for people who want to make their own mod. Every armor, weapon, pack, deployable, station, turret, sensor and vehicle sits in its own script file, with helper functions for the chores every mod repeats (damage scales, item limits per armor, ammo, station lists, a universal deploy function). It plays like base Tribes with an admin menu on top (server options, custom skins, spawn sets under Personal Settings). Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod FoundationII or use the toggle below; add your own items in Mods\FoundationII\scripts\FoundationIIServer.cs.
packs.author: ProtoManX (Foundation Mod by Nicodemus)
credits: Original mod: ProtoManX (Foundation Mod by Nicodemus)

packs.title: GammY[MK2]
packs.description: GammY[MK2] version 0.07 by Gammak7 (2003), a fork of {ATF}HaCk's {ATF} Mod, itself built on the Foundation mod. Nine armors (Light, Medium, Heavy, Goliath, Mechanic, Speedy, Flabby, Alien and DBZ) and about seventy weapons, from the stock guns to the BFG, FlameThrower, MiniGun, Star Cannon, Solar Flare, Spirit Bomb Attack, Kama-Ha-Ma-Ha Wave, Radio Strike, decoy launchers and two nukes. Deployable turrets, metal walls, force fields, spring pads, camo trees, shield and core generators, booster and teleport packs, displacer bombs and mines, and eight flyers including a Fog Maker and a Kamakazi Scout. Rough around the edges, as the author left it at 0.07. Server-side: it uses the game's own models, so people can join your server without installing anything; only the host needs the pack. Plays on the stock maps. Launch with -mod GammYMK2 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Gammak7; built on the {ATF} Mod by {ATF}HaCk and the Foundation mod by Nicodemus
credits: Built on the {ATF} Mod by {ATF}HaCk and the Foundation mod by Nicodemus

packs.title: Genocide v2R
packs.description: Genocide v2R by 6|6|6*SlipKnot* (September 2003), a big weapons mod from the Hybrid family: five armors (Sniper, Light, Medium, Heavy and the mod's own), more than 90 weapons with their own death messages, 10 vehicles, deployable turrets and a remote base, toxic / shock / sludge effects, a ten second fade-in when you spawn, and end-of-map player stats. Its admin system has four ranks (Server Master, God, Super, Public) with a Tab menu to kick, ban, change teams, punish and mute. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. No admin password ships with the pack; set names and passwords in Mods\Genocide\GenoServ.cs. Launch with -mod Genocide or use the toggle below.
packs.author: 6|6|6*SlipKnot* (a.k.a. +]-[+Armageddon+); administration coded by ]|420|[*CraCka

packs.title: Gundam Wing vx1
packs.description: GundamWvx1 (March 2001) by LoD|ZechsMerqise, built on Starsiege Craft 1.19: Gundam Wing mobile suits as Tribes armour classes. Everyone spawns in a Nakatu suit with a Laser Pistol and a Cutter and buys another suit at any inventory station: Wing, Wing Zero, Deathscythe, Deathscythe Hell, Heavyarms, Sandrock, Epyon, Tallgeese, Leo, Taurus, Virgo and more, armed from a list of about fifty weapons and packs (Energy Sword, Laser Sword, Heavy Shuriken, Particle Cannon, Storm Canon, Hellfire Missiles, Nuke Launcher, Tractor Beam, Web Gun). Six craft from the Core Fighter to the MotherShip, deployable turrets, sensors, stations, teleporters and launch pads. Fire modes are set under the Tab menu (Weapon Options). Server-side: it uses the game's own models, so people can join your server without installing anything; only the host needs the pack. Plays on the stock maps. Launch with -mod GundamWvx1 or use the toggle below.
packs.author: LoD|ZechsMerqise; built on Starsiege Craft 1.19 by Matthias (itself built on Warhammer 40k)
credits: Built on Starsiege Craft 1.19 by Matthias (itself built on Warhammer 40k)

packs.title: GunStar 0.5
packs.description: GunStar 0.5 by Nathan Sweet ([HvC]NaTeDoGG, author of HaVoC), from an idea by [OO]Striker: Tribes rebuilt around the weapon system of the old console shooter Gunstar Heroes. You carry two orbs out of four types, and what your gun fires depends on the orbs you hold. Press the grenade key to combine or split them, which gives each pair up to four different weapons. The author calls it unfinished and some weapons unbalanced; it is shipped as he left it. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod GunStar or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Nathan Sweet ([HvC]NaTeDoGG)

packs.title: Hard Corps
packs.description: HARD CORPS V1.5 FINAL (April 2000) by Warpath. A full Tribes server mod with 71 items: vehicle weapons, armor modules and its own packs, on eight Hard Corps maps (Blindside, DeadMan'sMine, Eye Of Horus, Seat Of Power, Wardance, Reach For The Sky, Whore Of Eirus, Zone Of Fire) that add three game types of their own (Stairway, Oversight, Tide Of Battle) to Capture the Flag. Its Tab menu has Player, Gameplay and Server option branches and a built-in help page, and the mod carries its own admin system with team-kill tracking. Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod HardCorps or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Warpath

packs.title: HaVoC
packs.description: HaVoC 1.6 by [HvC]NaTeDoGG, the last major release (July 2002). Ten armors (Scout, Spy, Light, Medium, Engineer, Infiltrator, Burster, Behemoth, Dragoon and the Cyborg) with a large arsenal, grappling hooks, teleporters, holograms and deployables, plus its own game types on top of CTF: Duel, Duel Tournament, Tribes Arena, Flag Hunter, Kill the Rabbit, Team Deathmatch and Tribes Racer. Ships 85 maps built for those game types. Built-in admin system with public admins, vote lockouts and anti team-kill levels, all set from the Tab menu or the settings file (Mods\HaVoC\HaVoC.cs). Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything; players who also install it get the eight Racer vehicle skins and the Duel announcer sounds. Launch with -mod HaVoC or use the toggle below.
packs.author: [HvC]NaTeDoGG (Nathan Sweet)

packs.title: Holocaust
packs.description: Holocaust 3.5 "With Duel" by /D:B/Spector (2001): a heavy-weapons server mod built on Meltdown, with the HaVoC duel maps added. Around 200 items: weapon modes chosen from the Tab menu (Chaingun Vulcan mode and others), more than a dozen deployable turrets, forcefields and blast doors, remote shield and cloaking nodes, teleport pads, mobile inventory and ammo stations, plus the Meltdown admin menu. Plays on Capture the Flag maps and brings two duel game types: ships 8 Duel maps, 8 Duel Tournament maps and the 10 stock CTF maps so all three types show in the mission menu. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod Holocaust or use the toggle below.
packs.author: /D:B/Spector (built on Meltdown by INH*DynaBlade, duel by [HvC]NaTeDoGG)
credits: Original mod: /D:B/Spector (built on Meltdown by INH*DynaBlade, duel by [HvC]NaTeDoGG)

packs.title: Tribes Hunters
packs.description: Tribes Hunters 1.4 by Tinman aka Kidney Thief (2000): the original Flag Hunter game type on stock weapons and armor. Every player carries a flag; kill someone, grab the flags he drops and bring them to the Nexus. Scoring is progressive (1 flag = 1 point, 2 = 3, 3 = 6 ...), so the longer you hoard the more you risk. Votable GREED mode (at least 8 flags to cap), HOARD mode (no caps near the end of the game) and TEAM Hunters; pick a player in the Tab menu and choose Track player to follow him on the command map. packs.title: Orion Mod
packs.description: Orion Mod by Jason Avina (February 2000): stock Tribes with ideas borrowed from Renegades, Shifter, Ideal and Balance of Power. Heavies get a Rocket Launcher that tracks whatever is in your sights and a Kamikaze Pack; everyone gets a Cloaking Device, a Heatsink that hides you from rocket turrets, a Teleport Pack back to a spawn point, a Command Laptop to run turrets from the field, and deployable Force Fields, Sentry Turrets and Missile Turrets that stick to walls and ceilings. The scout carries twin chainguns, medium and heavy armor can pilot the APCs, the laser rifle works without an energy pack, mines ignore teammates, remote inventory stations sell armor, and you spawn with a disc launcher and a repair kit. packs.title: OldTribes 0.3
packs.description: OldTribes v0.3 by Tom Vogt (April 2000). Stock weapons and items with slower, grounded movement: every armor has much higher ground traction and drag, lower side speed and a lower jump, and takes more damage before it dies. Light armor loses the grenade launcher and carries one mine. Team energy is no longer infinite: teams start with 5000 and equipment has to be paid for. Scoring is the Shifter-style advanced system, with bonuses for kills near the flag, killing or defending the flag runner, returning the flag, destroying or fully repairing base equipment, and penalties for hurting teammates or repairing enemy gear; your running score prints at the bottom of the screen. Every death costs a ten-second wait before you can respawn. Repeat team killers and players wrecking their own base are announced to the server. The Tab menu adds a personal-skins switch. Settings are in scripts\OldTribes.cs. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod OT or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Tom Vogt

packs.title: Paintball
packs.description: Paintball Mod v2.6 (2004) by |K0RN| and [RR]MisterPibb, reworked by KingTomato. Tribes as a paintball field: one light armor, eleven paintball markers (Delta, Spyder, Mongoose, Inferno, Psycho, Dragun, TipmannS, Shocker, AutoCocker, Intimidator, Angel) with clips to reload, burst/semi/safety fire modes on the Tab menu, paint grenades, and flashlight, laser-sight and camo packs. A hit to the mask does extra damage and scores a point. Client spending is on by default: create an account from chat (.create password), earn money for kills, captures and flag returns, and buy better markers at the inventory station; the account is kept between visits. Ships the seven PB_ maps of the earlier releases (speedball, canyon, ice and night fields). Server-side: people can join without installing anything. Launch with -mod Paintball or use the toggle below.

In their place are the AK-47, H&K MP5, AKSU-74, Dragunov SVD sniper rifle, Combat Shotgun, RPG, the DShK heavy machinegun and the Hellfire Artillery System with its ammo feed pack, plus an RPG Support Unit pack. The three armors become the Flack Jacket, Urban Assault Gear and Kevlar Body Armor. Everyone spawns in a Flack Jacket with an AK-47 and 75 rounds, a repair pack, a repair kit and three grenades. The Plasma Turret fires bullets instead of fusion bolts. The author's optional key-binding file (Shift+1 to Shift+8 for the new weapons) is not included. packs.title: SquadMod Alpha
packs.description: SquadMod release Alpha by KillerBunny (January 1999), one of the earliest server mods, aimed at organised squad and tournament play rather than new guns. Anti-TK (by Kaptain Kickass) warns, then kicks and bans repeat team killers. Beacons cannot be destroyed by the team that set them and expire after 200 seconds. Optional automatic weapon switching when you run dry, and an optional respawn delay that can grow with each death. In Tournament mode everyone types "ready" in chat and an admin starts the countdown from the Tab menu. A random quote can be shown at join. New equipment: a deployable Command Station and the Stinger missile launcher for medium armor (both by LabRat); medium and heavy armor energy and heavy armor speed are retuned. Settings are in scripts\SquadModPrefs.cs. The original settings program (SquadMod.exe) is not included. Server-side, so people can join your server without installing anything. Launch with -mod SquadMod or use the toggle below.
